title: Live to 100: What a 100-Year Life Would Really Mean in Ireland
seo_title: Live to 100 in Ireland: Planning a 100-Year Life | Compound
summary: A longer life raises a bigger question: what would we want those years to hold? An Irish perspective on money, health, relationships and the freedom to keep changing.
meta_description: What would living to 100 mean in Ireland? Explore healthspan, retirement, relationships and how to plan for a longer life without assuming you will reach 100.
